An '''alien''' was a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] working for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. They were the creator the [[Planet Killer]].

==Biography==
The [[Alien/Legends|alien]] was one of the creators of the [[Planet Killer]], a superweapon designed to destroy the planet that it was detonated on. The alien attempted to sell the weapon to [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], leader of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Unbeknownst to the alien scientist and Dooku, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] destroyed the Planet Killer, preventing the weapon from detonating. As a result, Dooku believed that the Planet Killer was inoperable and had a group of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1 battle droids]] arrest the scientist for wasting Dooku's time. As the scientist begged for mercy, Dooku stated that plans would continue to proceed for an "[[Death Star/Legends|ultimate weapon]]."<ref name="Run Mace Run" />
